The complete own printed bill AS MODIFIED under H.Res.988/report Part B is bound to this failed passage choice, rather than substituting the earlier unmodified RH. It preserves the quoted collective-bargaining clothes/washing branch; the ordinary education/training branch requires outside regular hours, voluntary participation without adverse action and no work for the employer. A separate apprenticeship-instruction branch uses the dated 29 CFR 785.32 reference and is not flattened into the same three conditions. The whole object is general statutory hours-worked treatment for FLSA sections 6/7, without a direct infrastructure, technical-system or technical-research mechanism; mentioning education does not establish one. Proposed exclusion does not decide individual compensability, require training, prohibit voluntary pay, or certify current regulation/application. The 209–215 recorded rejection with seven Not Voting overrides the preliminary voice result and did not itself enact the bill. No actual wage, job, training, technical outcome or motive is inferred.
